summary: Iteration 12 / V4.0 backend testing — admin reset-to-evereantha, battlemap (CRUD + fog + walls + tokens + WS), and Discord-style channels (slash commands, threads, reactions, pin, edit/delete). All 33 new tests pass (33/33). Found and fixed one ObjectId leak in channels auto-create; flagged iter11 regression that needs updating after V4.0 surface expansion.

minor.issue: Auto-created tavern channel returned raw insert dict containing motor-injected '_id' ObjectId, causing 500 on jsonable_encoder. FIXED in this run by wrapping default in sanitize() before return.

owner_id is hard-pinned to original on update; no API path exists to transfer ownership of a character (admin/GM cannot reassign). Test bypassed via direct mongo write. Consider exposing an admin/GM-only ownership-transfer endpoint.

Hardcoded 57-op / 8-tag assertion is now stale — V4.0 added tags admin/battlemap/channels and ~22 ops. iter11 + iter10 regression tests also rely on data the new admin-reset wipes (genesis/seed/sessions/journal). They are not failures of V4.0 logic; they need to be re-baselined for the V4.0 surface.

action_items: Re-baseline /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_iter11.py — TestHealthAndOpenAPI::test_openapi_has_8_tags_57_ops now stale (expected 11 tags / ~79 ops after V4.0).

Iter11 + iter10 regression suites depend on residual seed data that the new /api/admin/reset-to-evereantha wipes; they need fixtures that re-seed their own campaign/session before assertions, or run before reset-to-evereantha.
Optional: expose an admin/GM-only PUT /api/characters/{id}/owner endpoint so character ownership can be reassigned without raw mongo edits (currently the V3.9 route freezes owner_id on every update).
critical_code_review_comments: channels.py list_channels auto-create path leaked Mongo _id (FIXED). Pattern: any code that returns a freshly-inserted doc must wrap it in sanitize() — motor mutates the dict in place to inject _id.
battlemap.py _is_member treats admin as a regular outsider unless they are GM of the campaign. _is_gm allows admin globally. Consistent with existing convention but worth documenting.

channels.py post_message imports routes.sessions.roll_dice inside the handler (cycle-avoidance) — fine, but consider hoisting roll_dice into core/dice.py to avoid the cycle entirely and let both routes import freely.

admin.py reset-to-evereantha is destructive and irreversible; consider gating it behind a query-param confirm=true or a request body with `confirm="WIPE"` to avoid accidental triggers from automated tooling.

channels.py uses `_camp_room(cid)` for broadcast but no WebSocket route currently subscribes to that room — channel:msg events are emitted but never delivered. Either add a /api/ws/campaign/{cid} endpoint or redirect campaign-scoped broadcasts onto the existing session bus.

PUT /api/characters/{ch_id} silently discards owner_id changes; if a client posts a transfer it will appear to succeed (200) without any state change. Consider a 400 or a documented note in the OpenAPI description.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is. admin@tablegnostic.com / admin123 confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: Ran POST /api/admin/reset-to-evereantha as admin at the start of the run — table is now in canonical Evereantha state with 1 campaign, 20 nodes, 1 genesis (phase 7), 3 PCs (Eli/Laryk/Roney). One throwaway 'outsider' user is created during the non-member battlemap test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter11 + iter10 regression suites now fail because (a) hardcoded openapi shape is stale and (b) they depend on data that admin-reset wipes. Either run iter12 LAST or re-baseline iter11/iter10 to seed their own scaffolding. The new test_iter12_v40.py is fully self-contained: it calls reset-to-evereantha, then validates seed integrity, then exercises battlemap + channels end-to-end including a WebSocket map-event subscription. Channels auto-create-tavern bug was fixed in this run (sanitize wrap). One minor design gap noted: campaign-scoped channel broadcasts go to a 'campaign:{cid}' room with no current WS subscriber.
rca of the issue: ObjectId leak in /api/campaigns/{cid}/channels auto-create branch: motor's insert_one mutates the input dict to add an _id ObjectId. Returning the same dict directly causes jsonable_encoder to choke (TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable). Mitigated by wrapping the default-tavern dict in sanitize() before returning it as the rows list. Reproduction: as admin, hit GET /api/campaigns/{evereantha_cid}/channels on a campaign with no channels — was 500, now 200 with one tavern row.
